name: ProjectEval
description: ProjectEval is a benchmark for automated evaluation of project-level code generation by LLM agents, simulating user interaction and assessing generated projects through execution and code similarity metrics. It includes three levels of inputs such as natural language and code skeletons to evaluate systematic engineering project code and comprehensive analysis capabilities.
reputation: A recent benchmark for project-level code generation that is still early in adoption, but it is notable for moving beyond snippet-level coding tasks toward end-to-end project evaluation.
notes: Constructed by LLM with human reviewing; evaluates project-level code generation with user interaction simulation.
